template.about: LinnDrum-style rack, Minimoog-style bass, Oberheim brass, talkbox via vocoder.

project.name: 80s Boogie / Synth-Funk
project.notes:
80s BOOGIE / SYNTH-FUNK  (Zapp & Roger, D-Train, Kashif, The System; c. 1980-1986)

SOUND
LinnDrum grooves, synth bass played like a bass guitar, Oberheim brass stabs, clavinet,
talkbox leads, gated snare reverbs. Around 105-118 BPM (working range).

REFERENCE GEAR (sourced)
- Roger Troutman's talkbox rig (later era): a custom Electro-Harmonix Golden Throat driven by
  a Yamaha DX100 (MusicRadar, California Love). Other gear of the genre: unconfirmed here.

WORKFLOW
LinnDrum-style rack with 54% swing (The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.). Play the Moog Bass (Surge XT "Moogy Saw", mono,
built-in low-pass 1.2 kHz) on 16ths; OB brass stabs on the 2 and 4 offbeats.

MIX NOTES
- Space D on the Drum Bus with a short room cut off sharply for the gated snare; built-in bus
  compression.
- Brass bright; bass dry and mono.
- Master: built-in glue, Lemon Limiter; -10 to -9 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good, apart from the talkbox (TAL-Vocoder stands in) and the drums (synthesized one-shots, not LinnDrum samples).

SOURCES
MusicRadar "The making of 2Pac's California Love"; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- TAL-Vocoder (freeware): https://tal-software.com/products/tal-vocoder

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 112 BPM, 4/4, key Emin, cycle bars 1-4.

Tracks
- LinnDrum (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (LinnDrum) = kick-acoustic.wav, Snare (LinnDrum) = snare-acoustic.wav, Clap (LinnDrum) = clap.wav, Closed Hat (LinnDrum) = hat-acoustic.wav, Open Hat (LinnDrum) = openhat-acoustic.wav, Ride (LinnDrum) = ride.wav, Crash (LinnDrum) = crash.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (15 steps on), swing 54% (MPC terms), 7 rows = the rack's channels
- Moog Bass (Instrument, -5 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Leads/Moogy Saw"; A Play Mode 0.2
    strip FX: Filter (Cutoff 1200, Resonance 1, low-pass)
- OB Brass (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Brass/Obright Original"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -16 dB
- Talk Box (vocoder) (Instrument, -9 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Leads/Funk Lead"
    FX: TAL-Togu Audio Line: TAL-Vocoder-2: default settings
- Clav (Instrument, -11 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Keys/OBX Clavinet"
- Lead Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -16 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -22 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 4, Release 100, Make-up 2); Space D (Predelay 0, Dry 0, Wet -10, Decay 0.35, End Level 0, IR "00.5s Small Room")
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 2, Decay Curve 1, Output EQ High 2, IR "02.0s Hall")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 535.7, Feedback 0.4, Tone 3500, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Threshold -14, Ratio 2, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Lemon Limiter: gain +3 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
